title: amaranthus × ralletii subsp. soproniensis
intro: Amaranthus × ralletii subsp. soproniensis, commonly known as Sopron Red Amaranth, is a hybrid species of amaranth belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support antioxidant defenses. The therapeutic actions of Sopron Red Amaranth are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been associated with its use in traditional medicine. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic effects.
